title: Default widgets should be providing good accessibility defaults
body:
We need to ensure before releasing that we are good in term of accessibility (A11Y).

Funny eslint plugin: https://github.com/evcohen/eslint-plugin-jsx-a11y

We will need help from anyone skilled in a11y or just learn it.
